title: Cheat sheet of every shortcut
why: Type a word to filter. When you forget anything else, start here.

title: Launch any app
why: Start typing the app's name and press Enter.

title: Close the window you're in
why: Works on every app, the same way.

title: Jump between windows
why: Super with an arrow key moves to the window in that direction.

title: Go to desktop 1 to 9
why: Each desktop is one number away.

title: Send a window to another desktop
why: You go along with it.

title: Clipboard history
why: Everything you've copied recently, not just the last thing.

title: Show or hide the scratchpad
why: A hidden drawer that appears over whatever desktop you're on.

title: Put a window in the scratchpad
why: Take it out again with Super + Shift + a number.

title: Pop out and pin a window
why: It floats on top and follows you to every desktop. Great for a video call.

title: Float a window
why: Lifts it out of the tiles but leaves it on its own desktop.

title: Copy text from anywhere on screen
why: Drag a box around text in an image, video or locked PDF.

title: Stack windows as tabs
why: Several windows share one tile, like browser tabs.

title: Next tab in a group
why: Flip through the windows stacked in a group.

title: Back to the last desktop
why: Bounce between two desktops, like Alt + Tab for desktops.

title: Cycle through windows
why: Walks through the windows on this desktop.

title: Swap a window with its neighbor
why: Rearrange tiles without the mouse.

title: Make a window full width
why: Takes the whole desktop but keeps the bar and gaps. Press again to undo.

title: True full screen
why: Covers everything, bar included.

title: Flip side-by-side to stacked
why: Switches how two tiles share the space.

title: Resize a tile
why: Add Shift for height, Alt for a little, Ctrl for a lot.

title: Send a window away and stay put
why: Like Super + Shift + number, but you don't follow it.

title: Screenshot
why: Pick an area, a window or the whole screen.

title: Record the screen
why: Same picker as a screenshot, but video.

title: Grab any color on screen
why: Click a pixel and its hex code goes to the clipboard.

title: Emoji picker
why: Search and insert an emoji anywhere.

title: Share menu
why: Send the clipboard, a file or a folder to another device.

title: Dismiss a notification
why: Add Shift to clear them all.

title: Do not disturb
why: Silence notifications during a meeting or a recording.

title: Notifications you missed
why: Everything that popped up while you were away.

title: Calculator
why: A quick calculator on top of everything.

title: Set a reminder
why: A desktop notification in a few minutes.

title: Lock the screen
why: Before you walk away.

title: Hide or show the top bar
why: A little more room for a presentation.

title: Make a window solid
why: Turns off transparency for the window you're in.

title: Switch themes
why: Pick a new look for the whole desktop.

title: Change the wallpaper
why: Pick from the current theme's wallpapers.

title: System menu
why: Lock, suspend, restart or shut down.

title: Switch this desktop's layout
why: Toggles between tiling layouts.

title: Pseudo-tile a window
why: Keeps its own size inside its tile.
